title: warren.run ships analytics tags as the only client JS
rationale: Google Ads campaign (2026-08-13) needs conversion measurement; the landing page zero-JS constraint was relaxed to exactly the tags in src/config/analytics.ts (Vercel insights + gtag behind PUBLIC_GTAG_ID). The conversion event is the outbound click to github.com/jayminwest/warren because the campaign goal is repo stars. Bundle budgets + a test still ban any other JS on / and /changelog.
